title: Magical Peru
short_description: Discover Lima, Paracas, Huacachina, Cusco, Machu Picchu, Humantay Lake, Abode of the Gods and Rainbow Mountain in 9 days.
long_description:
Discover the magic of Peru on a 9-day, 8-night journey combining culture, history, nature and adventure.

Begin in Lima, continue through Paracas, Ica and Huacachina, and travel to the Andes for Cusco, Machu Picchu, Humantay Lake, the Abode of the Gods and Rainbow Mountain.
price_note: From USD 569 per person. Ask about availability and conditions.
seo_title: Magical Peru 9 Days / 8 Nights | GT Peru Travel

days.title: Day 1: Arrival in Lima
days.text: Airport reception, transfer and free time to discover Miraflores and Pacific views.

days.title: Day 2: Paracas – Ica – Huacachina
days.text: Ballestas Islands boat tour, wine tasting and lunch in Ica, and Huacachina dune buggies and sandboarding. Return to Lima.

days.title: Day 3: Lima – Cusco
days.text: Travel to Cusco, reception and acclimatization day at approximately 3,400 m.

days.title: Day 4: Cusco City Tour
days.text: Visit the Cathedral, Qorikancha, Sacsayhuaman, Qenqo, Puka Pukara and Tambomachay.

days.title: Day 5: Machu Picchu
days.text: Train to Aguas Calientes, bus and guided visit to Machu Picchu on the assigned circuit. Return to Cusco.

days.title: Day 6: Humantay Lake
days.text: Breakfast, 1.5 to 2-hour hike to Humantay Lake, guided visit, lunch and return.

days.title: Day 7: Abode of the Gods
days.text: Visit Apukunaq Tiana, Goblins Valley, Ents Forest and Huasao Wetland.

days.title: Day 8: Rainbow Mountain
days.text: Breakfast in Cusipata, 1.5 to 2-hour hike to Vinicunca, lunch and return.

days.title: Day 9: Farewell
days.text: Free time and coordinated transfer to Cusco Airport.
